verdict.rationale: Carta publishes a first-party per-endpoint API reference (cap table, stakeholders, option grants, convertible notes, FMV). It also offers a playground environment that returns static but valid responses without real credentials, and a first-party guide to running its APIs in Postman, so examples can be executed. However, nothing shows the reference itself is interactive (no in-page 'try it' console), and no OpenAPI spec was found at any probed path. missing for 10: evidence of an in-browser interactive 'try it' console in the reference, embedded runnable code samples, a public OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.
